title: Can You Undo It? Reversibility Classes for AI Agent Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.22075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using AI agents change files, databases, access rights and public information, yet permission to call a tool does not establish whether a mistake can be undone. We present Reversibility Classes, a declared five-level vocabulary with argument-sensitive rules, conservative defaults and an explicit prior-state capture contract. The pinned implementation and evidence-linked registry cover 536 tools across 20 MCP servers. All 738 rule-case checks conform to declared expectations, while native annotation mapping differs from draft registry labels for 118 of 481 comparable tools. One AI-assisted reviewer approves 148 ratings, 75 matching the registry; this is not independent agreement. On 2,158 recorded runs, the implemented session guard gates the associated action in all 29 attributable attack-positive runs, compared with 18 for a read/write proxy, while adding nine approval points across 1,209 benign runs. translated_title: 你能撤销它吗？面向AI智能体动作的可逆性分类
translated_abstract: 使用工具的AI智能体会更改文件、数据库、访问权限和公开信息，然而允许调用某个工具并不意味着其产生的错误可以被撤销。我们提出了可逆性分类（Reversibility Classes），这是一个声明式的五级词汇体系，包含参数敏感的规则、保守的默认值以及明确的先验状态捕获契约。其固定版本的实现和带有证据链接的注册表涵盖了20个MCP服务器上的536个工具。全部738项规则用例检查均符合声明预期，而在481个可比较的工具中，有118个工具的原生注解映射与注册表草案标签不一致。一名AI辅助审核员批准了148项评级，其中75项与注册表匹配，但这并非独立的一致性验证。在2,158次记录的运行中，所实现的会话守卫在全部29次可归因的攻击阳性运行中拦截了相关动作，而读写代理仅拦截了18次，同时在1,209次良性运行中仅新增了9个审批点。在受控的文件、Git、SQLite等环境中……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出“可逆性分类”——一个声明式的五级词汇体系，通过参数敏感规则、保守默认值和先验状态捕获契约来判定AI智能体工具动作能否被撤销，其实现的会话守卫在攻击场景下能拦截全部29次可归因的攻击阳性运行，优于读写代理基线（仅18次），且对良性运行的干扰极小。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Reversibility Classes, a declared five-level vocabulary with argument-sensitive rules, conservative defaults, and an explicit prior-state capture contract for assessing whether AI agent tool actions can be undone, whose implemented session guard blocks all 29 attributable attack-positive runs compared to only 18 for a read/write proxy, while adding just nine approval points across 1,209 benign runs.
